item.title: Sen. Mitch McConnell says he's been discharged from rehab
item.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell has been released from a rehab center after being hospitalized nearly two months ago, according to CBS News' Taurean Small.

item.title: Police investigate suspicious disappearance of Arizona family
item.description: Authorities are looking into possible foul play after three family members went missing from their home in Avondale, Arizona.

item.title: Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt
item.description: A Senate committee voted Thursday to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress for invoking the Fifth Amendment at a hearing last week.

item.title: McConnell discharged from rehab after hospitalization
item.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky was hospitalized on June 14.
